decisions.reason: The turnaround management software sits close to the core offer and has kept its own page for two years, so its value is still unresolved but promising, and carrying a software product costs little.
The apron connectivity module moved from a mention to its own page, which signals growing commitment, and keeping it open as an option for integrated digital operations is cheap.
Billing software sits a little further from the operational core, but it was upgraded to its own page and its carrying cost is low, so the option is still worth holding.
Equipment monitoring fits the data-driven maintenance strategy and builds on the installed base, and its upgraded presentation suggests the uncertainty about its value is resolving favorably.
